description: Page reader for up to 10 URLs in one call. Same as read for up to 10 URLs at once (cheaper per page; 20,000 characters per page by default). A page that fails is reported inline as {url, error}. Returns {count, failed, results[]}. Price: $0.03 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails.
name: read_batch

failed.description: Pages that failed (reported inline with url and error)

results.description: One entry per input, in input order

content.description: The page as clean markdown or plain text

error.description: Set instead of content when this page failed

finalUrl.description: Where the fetch ended after redirects

links.description: Links inside the content, deduplicated, up to 200

region.description: Element the content came from: main, article, role-main, body or document

truncated.description: True when maxChars cut the content

title: Page reader (batch of 10)
